svg.title: Teacher sequence distillation and checkpoint/KL-divergence schematic
svg.desc: Inventory: upper-left teacher sequence stack with diagonal label and arrow feeds a central teacher block; left database cylinder contains D^s, D_i, D_e and two example image patches; gray and red paths from the dataset/examples feed teacher, student, and prior-time blocks; three central blocks output arrows to red/gray logit bars with turquoise KL links; bottom legend explains checkpoint-at-task-change dotted arrow, KL divergence diamond link, and red/gray logits. Symmetry/equipartition basis: central processing blocks are vertically aligned on a shared left edge, logit columns align to a common right-side grid, and the legend is horizontally partitioned into symbol-text pairs. SAM mappings used after full native construction: original top central T_t block - node_Tt_draft - asset_sam_region_000029; original S_t block - node_St_draft - asset_sam_region_000028; original S_{t-1} block - node_Stm1_draft - asset_sam_region_000027; original two example pictures - draft_photo_top/draft_photo_bottom - asset_sam_region_000030/000031; original legend checkpoint and KL symbols - legend_checkpoint_symbol/legend_kl_symbol - asset_sam_region_000025/000024.

g.title: Database cylinder holding task/data sets D^s with D_i and D_e partitions
Red D_e logits and gray D_i logits arranged in aligned output columns
